result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, I'd recommend **Stripe as the best all-round payment processor**, with **PayPal as an additional checkout option**\.

However, if you're operating in Australia, there are a few particularly good options worth comparing.

## Best payment processors for a small online store

![Expert Pricing – Tutora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/s215eOkCrBJePJ6aedIAPORR2dSQKpg4r3kdjo_wlgJnHkyQ2l5DLHu9GE6cuq7DyIdsT5AkGFo_O1lteac7Hs-JP8Zcc66y70mgHCRBP4oIOblvA2wYsTXPnCEklYN9pAD0oC9n8Sn7qYbRw4Qg_jr4Bc3IEn5KMxhAijD_r0bRoq8DtkAmGOw6J64vSDi0?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Easy integration with most online stores.
- Accepts credit cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Excellent reporting and fraud protection.
- No standard monthly processing fee.

Australian domestic card pricing: approximately 1.65% + A\$0.30.

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

(Best for customer familiarity)

- Customers recognise and trust the brand.
- Easy checkout integration.
- Supports PayPal payments and card payments.
- Can help customers feel comfortable purchasing from a new store.

Australian domestic pricing: approximately 2.9% + A\$0.30.

[PayPal Australia](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square**

- Good for businesses selling online and in person.
- Combines payment processing and inventory management.
- Straightforward setup.
- Useful if you also have a physical shop or market stall.

[Square Australia](https://squareup.com/au/en)

---

![Shopify Payments en México 2026: Comisiones y Cuándo Conviene | Atémpora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uaDWm9NONCBgwuJmZgfert_G31d46hLlI4IfJXvnluf3W2KNJh1m0Hd6lZrNGAPmsyHRrilMlk9B4682s-cn40d1cp-SjQrlAzuD2UEX8iNzkLVIhiPrHZ-Q-BYlhpFfZG8FNzWKzH1o7gk5YwcfdyrA6rRsIlL4g3Z9SJ_DAnqpO6UXb7hjSC1HIAun6cGh?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Shopify Payments**

- Best if your store runs on Shopify.
- Integrated checkout and order management.
- Supports major cards and digital wallets.
- Avoids additional Shopify third-party transaction fees.

[Shopify Payments Australia](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Airwallex Logo Vector PNG | Modern Global Payments Brand Icon  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cFbGTguMuX4NolZbruyR2e9UuMWzIcApce9GwnB52sKTkNYR004hxhoF8Ij9azaRbMXEJgKRHsclL3c7QjB8TJjaOTDcrg4k3A5inD7vzblx0d1z3hgdBOQOwY04EZUWK2_K2j2_0mXQsLUCmgN2eSvYqOiDe6vtcOsjp3z8pqXOq4rreZAlQfF7YiTD92T7?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Airwallex**

- Particularly good for international businesses.
- Competitive Australian domestic card fees.
- Multi-currency payment collection.
- Useful for businesses buying and selling internationally.

[Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

Indicative Australian pricing based on published provider comparisons in 2026. Actual fees depend on card type, payment method, plan and transaction origin. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For a new small online store, I'd start with\:

- **Stripe** for your main credit and debit card processing.
- **PayPal** as an additional payment option.
- Add Apple Pay and Google Pay where supported.

This gives customers several convenient ways to pay without making your payment setup unnecessarily complicated.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I'd like to recommend the best option based on your actual business rather than just the most popular provider.

**1\. What platform is your online store using?**
